$source: Corporate Security Handbook (FASA 7118) Security Personnel p.106-121 and Archetypes p.121-124, transcribed from 170 dpi page renders (the PDF has no text layer). `boosted` = a parenthesised figure that always applies; `conditional` = a starred figure that applies only when decking or rigging (kept in the bio, not on the sheet). `dice` = the printed total Initiative dice.

contacts.name: Executive Protection Adept
powers: Improved Physical Senses (Flare Compensation, Low-Light Vision, Vision Magnification 2)
contacts.blurb: The execsec team's advance man: superior perception and stealth to watch the mundane world and astral space at once, quick to spot trouble and quick to stop it.

contacts.name: Executive Protection Decker
cyber: Cranial Cyberdeck (MPCP 8, Persona 8, Hardening 4, Memory: Active 100 Mp, Storage 500 Mp, Input/Output 80, Response Increase 2)
contacts.blurb: Rides the Matrix for the client: reservations, contacts, dealings and itineraries, black information, misinformation planted, and the police, rescue and air-traffic frequencies watched.

contacts.name: Executive Protection Mage
cyber: Cybereyes with Electronic Magnification 3, Flare Compensation and Low-Light
contacts.blurb: Not an ordinary mage: protection, detection and offensive spells juggled with equal ability, and always ready to give immediate magical medical aid.

contacts.name: Executive Protection Rigger
cyber: Cybereyes with Flare Compensation, Low-Light and Thermographic
contacts.blurb: Coordinates all of the client's transportation: armored vehicles, drones, air and water transport. Never call one a chauffeur.

contacts.name: Executive Protection Specialist
cyber: Cybereyes with Electronic Magnification 3, Flare Compensation, Low-Light, Rangefinder and Thermographic
contacts.blurb: The client's personal shield and the basic unit of every execsec team: trained to protect the client's life even at the cost of their own, and far more than a muscleman.

contacts.name: Investigator
contacts.blurb: Trained in espionage, interview and interrogation, and data gathering; handles every security investigation involving personnel.

contacts.name: Magical Security Specialist
contacts.skillsBoosted: Firearms 3 (4) and Unarmed Combat 4 (5) with the Improved Ability powers.
powers: Improved Physical Senses (Flare Compensation, Low-Light Vision)
contacts.blurb: Specialists in one area of magical security, most often wards, astral monitoring or conjuring; usually the most egocentric of all security personnel, and worth their weight in gold.

contacts.name: Magical Security Engineer
contacts.blurb: A mundane, and proud of it: magical theory, the physical sciences and trial and error, building technical aids such as fiber-optic viewing systems and defenses such as bacterial containment grids.

contacts.name: Personnel Security Specialist
contacts.blurb: The backbone of corporate persec: background checks on candidates, employees and associates, monitoring work habits, and security clearances.

contacts.name: Security Commander
cyber: Cybereyes with Flare Compensation, Low-Light, and Thermographic
contacts.blurb: No office drone: she has served on the front lines, commands every security force on patrol like a general, and sees security as nothing short of war.

contacts.name: Security Decker
contacts.gear: Appropriate cyberdeck and programs (MPCP equal to twice Professional Rating + 1).
contacts.blurb: The meat behind the corporate IC: a shark patrolling her corporation's nodes, watching for break-ins and internal anomalies.

contacts.name: Security Executive
contacts.blurb: Head of the security division: organization, budgets and boards of directors, never the front lines. His head is the first to roll after a serious breach.

contacts.name: Security Guard
contacts.blurb: The most numerous and visible member of the physec team: checkpoints and foot patrols, entry-level and minimally trained.

contacts.name: Security Mage
cyber: Cybereyes with Flare Compensation, Low-Light, and Thermographic
contacts.blurb: Sets up a site's magical protection and monitors the astral paths and magical defenses on duty; prefers to slow intruders down and capture them.

contacts.name: Security Officer
contacts.blurb: Responsible for the complete security of one location, answering only to the security commander; the next generation of commanders.

contacts.name: Security Rigger
cyber: Cybereyes with Flare Compensation, Low-Light, and Thermographic
contacts.blurb: The newest member of the team: through CCSS and a system control rig she monitors and controls the whole technical security system, and can still drive a pretty mean drone.

contacts.name: Security Specialist: Animal Handler
cyber: Cybereyes with Flare Compensation, Low-Light, and Thermographic
contacts.blurb: Trained to handle, control and command security animals, paranormal and mundane; some have worked with the rare cybered animal.

contacts.name: Security Specialist: Fast Response Officer
cyber: Cybereyes with Flare Compensation, Low-Light, and Thermographic
contacts.blurb: Special Weapons and Tactics: deployed at a moment's notice to engage intruders, outfitted with state-of-the-art weapons, and they don't take prisoners.

archetypes.name: Freelance Executive Protection Specialist (Troll)
cyber: Skillsofts: Biotech 3, and (4) Etiquette skillsofts at 3 points each
archetypes.gear: Ares Predator II (with 4 spare clips); Concealed Holster; DocWagon™ Contract (Gold); Fineblade Long Blade; Form-Fitted Body Armor: 3; Medkit; Pocket Secretary; Portable Phone (Earplug with Booster); Tres Chic Clothing. Contacts: choose (2). Starting cash 1,255¥ + (3D6 × 1,000¥).
archetypes.note: Natural thermographic vision, +1 Reach for armed/unarmed combat, and natural dermal armor (1). Choose an allergy if using that option (SR2 p.46).
archetypes.blurb: Not a low-life gang member or thug but a highly trained, dedicated professional who has tailored body and mind to one duty: keeping clients alive. Many grow closer to their clients than family, and some are worth more than the people they guard.

archetypes.name: Freelance Magical Security Consultant
archetypes.gear: Fetishes: (1) Combat, (1) Detection, (2) Illusion, (1) Manipulation; Narcoject Pistol; Pocket Secretary; Secure Long Coat. Cyberware: none. Contacts: choose (2). Starting cash 3D6 × 1,000¥.
archetypes.blurb: A one-time astral intruder now working for the corps: devises ingenious traps that stop or detain intruders, designs and implements magical security systems, and bills for everything.

archetypes.name: Freelance Security Rigger
archetypes.conditional: Reaction 9 and Initiative 9 + 3D6 when rigged; Control Pool 9 when rigged (5 otherwise).
cyber: Cybereyes with Flare Compensation, Flare Protection and Thermographic
archetypes.gear: Ares Viper Slivergun (with 2 spare clips and 90 flechette rounds); Camo Jacket; Dataline Tap: 6; DocWagon™ Contract (Platinum); Form-Fitted Body Armor: 3; Remote Control Deck with (4) Slave Ports, ECM (Security I)/ECCM (Security I) (Rigger Black Book p.127; disregard if that book is unavailable), Internal Rigger Decryption Module: 6, Internal Rigger Protocol Emulation Module: 6. Contacts: choose (2). Starting cash 1,130¥ + (3D6 × 1,000¥).
archetypes.blurb: The oddball of the security business: hours jacked into a building's system, monitoring everything from drones to maglocks. Provides only deck, training and innate ability; the client supplies everything else.

archetypes.name: Security System Design Engineer (Dwarf)
archetypes.gear: Computer Tool Kit; Dataline Tap (1); Electronics Tool Kit; External Rigger Decryption Module (1); External Rigger Protocol Emulation Module (1); Pocket Computer with 100 Mp Memory; Remote Control Deck with two Slave Ports; Wrist Phone with Flip-Up Screen. Contacts: choose (2). Starting cash 155¥ + (3D6 × 1,000¥).
archetypes.note: Natural thermographic vision, and +2 Body for disease resistance only. Choose an allergy if using that option.
archetypes.blurb: The master of the security puzzle: assembles, tests, rechecks, repairs and redesigns a system to keep it at peak efficiency, and so becomes a target for kidnapping, extortion, bribery and extraction.
